blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Michelin Guide announced FLOW as the latest addition to the Philippines’ Michelin-starred restaurants on October 29. Located along Chino Roces Avenue in Makati, the fine-dining establishment brings the country’s total to 10 starred restaurants. However, the Guide’s 2027 selection recognized 127 establishments in all.ments in all. Yet, if so many restaurants received recognition, why did only 10 earn stars? What criteria does the Michelin Guide use when evaluating restaurants, and what are its limitations? More importantly, does being left out mean a restaurant isn’t any good?
